# Switch NX2 - read when the Lichii GUI starts.
# One NAME=VALUE per line. Lines starting with # are ignored.
# A variable already set in the environment wins over this file.
# Between files, the user copy (%APPDATA%\eden\nx2_switches.txt, or
# $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/eden/nx2_switches.txt) wins over this one, so editing this file is never
# needed: copy the lines you want into your own and restart.
# Beside-application files accept EDEN_NX2_* and the emulator's diagnostic switches only.
# Host environment settings, including library paths such as EDEN_STREAMLINE_DIR, must be
# set in the real environment or the user configuration file at an absolute config location.
#
# Restart the emulator after editing.

# GPU thread split: NOT forced on by default. On low-end hardware the mesh/task indirect
# draws read before the GPU writers commit the page map and the scene goes black in bursts
# (measured with EDEN_NX2_FLASH_WATCH); the OOT preset disables the split for that reason.
# If your card is not VRAM-bound and you want +54% in the menus/between scenes, set
# EDEN_NX2_SPLIT=2 in your own nx2_switches.txt (%APPDATA%\eden\nx2_switches.txt) - your copy
# wins over this one, and over the preset.
#EDEN_NX2_SPLIT=2

# Batch GPU fence syncpoints to reduce host driver overhead and smooth frametimes.
EDEN_NX2_FENCE_BATCH=1

# Leave buffer downloads disabled on Switch 2 (default): forcing downloads (=1) copies back
# 90-220 MB/s of buffers CPU never touches, causing heavy mutex contention and dropping FPS by ~38-63%.
#EDEN_NX2_BUFFER_DOWNLOADS=1

# Which fence the game waits for when it presents. 1 = the previous frame's: the game prepares the
# next frame while the GPU finishes this one, and waits for this one too while the GPU is behind.
# 0 = this frame's: no overlap. Any value other than 1 means 0, so =2 does not run two frames ahead.
# Unset: per title. Ocarina of Time uses 1, Donkey Kong Bananza 0, and other titles wait for this
# frame unless a GPU channel waits on a semaphore the game releases after the present.
# Ocarina of Time with =0 (or =2): 30.9 fps against 38.9 unset, same spot and settings.
#EDEN_NX2_FRAMES_AHEAD=1

# --- Workarounds / Debug ---
# Independent floating-point knobs for the 3050. Lowers geometry cost of the built-in tessellation:
# EDEN_NX2_TESS_SCALE multiplies every tessellation factor the hull shader writes (0..1; keep at
# least 0.5 to avoid visible LOD pop). Try 0.5 if Death Mountain walls hurt the frame rate.
#EDEN_NX2_TESS_SCALE=0.5
#
# On desktop Vulkan the scheduler submits native-tiled work every 4096 draws (MoltenVK keeps 128).
# Lowering this batches fewer draws per submit at the cost of more submissions.
#EDEN_NX2_FLUSH_DRAWS=4096
#
# Unattended/headless launches: apply the Ocarina 60 FPS preset (with Max Resolution) without
# asking at the boot dialog, and enable the built-in Dynamic FPS and Max Resolution patches.
# Useful for test harnesses and automated benchmarking; has no effect on other games.
#EDEN_NX2_OOT_PRESET=1
#
# Graphics scale reported to Switch 2 titles via the nx2 graphics-scale service. 10 = the
# game's default, 20 = a lower render/output mode, 30 = the lowest. For The Legend of Zelda:
# Ocarina of Time, 20 presents 2560x1440 instead of 3840x2160 (verified) and 30 is lower. This
# is the switch to pair with the DLSS gauge on low-end cards.
#EDEN_NX2_GRAPHICS_SCALE=20
#
# Terrain/indirect drawing fix for Donkey Kong Bananza: enabled by default. Set to 0 only to leave to GPU.
#EDEN_NX2_RESETFIX=0

# Drop reactive-flushing read traps on Switch 2 programs (opt-in; can reduce FPS from 29 to 24 in MKW).
#EDEN_NX2_NO_REACTIVE=1

#EDEN_NX2_MME_JIT=0
#EDEN_NX2_SKIP_SAME=0
#EDEN_NX2_INLINE_DEFER=0
#EDEN_NX2_SPLIT_SKIP=1
#EDEN_NX2_AUTO_STUB=1
#EDEN_NX2_KEEP_ASTC=1
# Threads for each shader warm-up (compute, then graphics), 1 to 32. They run at low priority.
#EDEN_NX2_WARM_THREADS=4
# The warm-up builds only while the game is paused or from Emulation > Prepare Shaders Now;
# =1 lets it build while the game runs too.
#EDEN_NX2_WARM_WHILE_PLAYING=1
# Warm-up builds skip our vulkan_pipelines file (only the driver's cache keeps them); =1 adds
# them to it.
#EDEN_NX2_WARM_APP_CACHE=1

# Background pipeline-cache compiler threads. Unset: hardware threads minus one. On this PC
# (Ryzen 5 3600, 6 GB 3050) 3 is enough; more just thrash the GPU drivers\' shared budget and
# the JIT threads during Kokiri'\''s load-in. Nothing is applied to the fork as a default -
# copy into your own nx2_switches.txt to use it.
#EDEN_NX2_PIPELINE_WORKERS=3
